WITH order_delivery_times AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_state,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS delivery_days
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
),
long_delivery_orders AS (
    SELECT

        COUNT(*) AS total_orders
    FROM order_delivery_times
    WHERE delivery_days > 30
    GROUP BY customer_state
)
SELECT 
    customer_state,
    total_orders
FROM long_delivery_orders
ORDER BY total_orders DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) AS year_num,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) IN (2017, 2018)
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.shipping_limit_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.shipping_limit_date)
),
revenue_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year_num) AS revenue_2017,
    total_revenue AS revenue_2018
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  ROUND(
    ((revenue_2018 - revenue_2017) / revenue_2017) * 100, 
    2
  ) AS growth_percentage
FROM revenue_comparison
WHERE revenue_2017 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_num

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year_num,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
    AND o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced')
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp),
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
revenue_with_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    year_num,
    total_revenue,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year_num) AS prev_year_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  ROUND(
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_year_revenue IS NOT NULL AND prev_year_revenue > 0 
      THEN ((total_revenue - prev_year_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_year_revenue)
      ELSE NULL 
    END, 2
  ) AS growth_percentage
FROM revenue_with_growth
WHERE year_num = 2018
ORDER BY month_num

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date) AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date) AS year,
    SUM(fs.total_value) AS total_revenue
  FROM fact_sales fs
  JOIN dim_date d ON fs.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date >= '2017-01-01' AND d.full_date < '2018-09-01'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date)
),
revenue_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_revenue,
    total_revenue AS current_year_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  ROUND(
    ((current_year_revenue - prev_year_revenue) / prev_year_revenue) * 100, 
    2
  ) AS growth_percentage
FROM revenue_comparison
WHERE prev_year_revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND month_num BETWEEN 1 AND 8
ORDER BY month_num

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date) AS month,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date) AS year,
    SUM(fs.total_value) AS total_revenue
  FROM fact_sales fs
  JOIN dim_date d ON fs.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date >= '2017-01-01' AND d.full_date <= '2018-08-31'
    AND d.full_date >= '2017-01-01' AND d.full_date <= '2018-08-31'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date)
),
revenue_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_revenue,
    total_revenue AS current_year_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  month AS "bulan",
  ROUND(
    ((current_year_revenue - prev_year_revenue) / prev_year_revenue) * 100,
    2
  ) AS "persentase_pertumbuhan"
FROM revenue_comparison
WHERE prev_year_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    d.month_key,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date) AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date) AS year_num,
    SUM(f.total_value) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date >= '2017-01-01' AND d.full_date < '2018-09-01'
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY d.month_key, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.full_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.full_date)
),
revenue_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    year_num,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year_num) AS prev_year_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  month_num AS "bulan",
  ROUND(
    ((revenue - prev_year_revenue) / prev_year_revenue) * 100, 
    2
  ) AS "persentase_pertumbuhan"
FROM revenue_comparison
WHERE year_num = 2018 AND prev_year_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_num

WITH seller_items AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_state,
        s.seller_id,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as total_items
    FROM sellers s
    JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
      AND s.seller_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG')
    GROUP BY s.seller_state, s.seller_id
),
ranked_sellers AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_state,
        seller_id,
        total_items,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_state ORDER BY total_items DESC) as rn
    FROM seller_items
)
SELECT 
    seller_state as negara_bagian,
    seller_id as id_penjual,
    total_items as jumlah_item
FROM ranked_sellers
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY seller_state, rn

WITH seller_items AS (

        ds.state_key,
        ds.seller_id,
        SUM(fs.order_item_id) AS total_items
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_seller ds ON fs.seller_key = ds.seller_key
    JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.purchase_date_key = dd.date_key
    JOIN dim_year dy ON dd.month_key = dim_month.month_key AND dim_month.year_key = dy.year_key
    WHERE dy.year_key = 2018
      AND ds.state_key IN (12, 19, 21) -- SP, RJ, MG
    GROUP BY ds.state_key, ds.seller_id
),
ranked_sellers AS (
    SELECT 
        state_key,
        seller_id,
        total_items,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_key ORDER BY total_items DESC) AS rn
    FROM seller_items
)
SELECT 
    ds.state_code AS state,
    rs.seller_id,
    rs.total_items AS total_items
FROM ranked_sellers rs
JOIN dim_state ds ON rs.state_key = ds.state_key
WHERE rs.rn <= 3
ORDER BY ds.state_code, rs.total_items DESC
